text:
emma_fin: Quick sync: launching a micro A/B for RATE_REFRESH next Wed 09:00 PT. 7% traffic into NEW_CARD. Need billing-safe rollback, explicit exempt list handling, and a simulated invoice pass. @jordi_devops @priya_billing @nate_cs please confirm readiness.
jordi_devops: Confirmed. Rollout will be controlled by a feature weight flag per route. We can cut weight to 0 instantly. I'll add a router-level guard that rejects any request where meter_id isn't in the migration table.
priya_billing: From billing: we need the vendor mapping + a checksum; otherwise meter mismatches will split revenue. Plan to run a dry invoice against the 15 exempt enterprise accounts + 30 PAYG accounts. Will build a migration table with `exempt` boolean.
nate_cs: CS: those 15 accounts must be excluded. I'll re-verify the IDs and upload to Drive. If any exempt acct sees NEW_CARD charges during canary we will halt immediately and open support.
vendor_zara: I'll push the mapping JSON to s3: s3://vendor-exports/rate_refresh_225555.json and post sha256. Format: {"meter_id","sku","unit_cents","tiers"}. Posting sha256 after upload.
emma_fin: Action list: 1) vendor_zara upload mapping + sha256 2) priya run simulated invoice + create `rate_migration_v225` table with `exempt` flag 3) jordi add parity guard + metric 4) nate confirm exempt list.
jordi_devops: Technical: I'll implement a quick parity probe that validates the first 400 routed requests have meter_id lookups. Emit metric `billing.migrate.missing_meter_count`. PD if >0.25% in 15m. Also will add a soft fallback to LEGACY_CARD for unmapped IDs to avoid hard failures.
priya_billing: Sim plan: ingest vendor JSON -> create `rate_migration_v225`. Run simulated invoice at 2x sample traffic. SQL snippet: ```sql
-- reconcile snippet
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) events, SUM(amount_cents) total_cents FROM simulated_charges WHERE run_tag='rr_canary_225' GROUP BY account_id;
```
vendor_zara: Upload done: s3://vendor-exports/rate_refresh_225555.json sha256: f9c8b7a6... LMK if you prefer CSV.
billing-bot: [automated] Billing queue: 12 pending, avg latency 10s. Last full invoice: 2026-03-22T03:00Z.
priya_billing: Imported mapping and added `exempt` flags from Drive list https://drive.redwood/drive/1Kx... Starting simulated invoice now; ETA ~90m. Will post summary and per-account diffs.
nate_cs: Verified exempt list matches prod IDs. CS holds go/no-go based on simulated invoice results showing zero NEW_CARD charges for those accounts.
emma_fin: (typo) sorry emma_fin: Proposed rollbacks: - any exempt acct billed at NEW_CARD OR - aggregate invoice variance >4.5% in canary cohort over 20m OR - `billing.migrate.missing_meter_count` >0.3% in first 15m. Trigger -> immediate 0% + ops/manual review.
jordi_devops: Will add the healthcheck endpoint that returns current mapping sha256 and counts of unmapped meters. I'll post runbook link when ready.
priya_billing: Simulated invoice results: no exempt acct billed. PAYG samples show 0.6% variance largely due to tier rounding. Uploading report to Drive.
emma_fin: Good. CS & Billing to sign off at 08:30 PT day-of. If all clear, proceed with 7% weight at 09:00 then monitor 2h. :white_check_mark:
